audit.why: 46.63% over 2342 games with HARD / 7.0 difficulty is consistent, and the chart (Nautilus 1-5, Skill at 6 and first item, Nautilus late) matches the packet row for row in both phases[N].side and win[N].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states that Dredge Line is a projectile that stops on the first unit it hits, and gives no ranges or cooldowns for the two abilities the lane revolves around.
audit.why: Riot's own text says the anchor pulls the enemy it collides with — a minion eats the hook. That is the single actionable defence for a 425-range dasher against a 1150-range engage, and it was missing. Depth Charge at 825 range needs no aim, so it cannot be dodged the same way.
audit.corrected: spikes[0].text, spikes[2].text, whys[2], report[5].t and dosFull[0].d now carry Dredge Line's 1150 range / 14s, its first-unit collision, Titan's Wrath's 12s, and Depth Charge's 825 range.
